notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1.2
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers!

This new hotfix fixes some glitches that is reported in following post.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1273320/discussions/0/2271447149932594151/#c2299597907723355340

In summary:

1. Another 2 points where you can go through walls.
2. Multiple endings play at same time.
3. The record that player has reached ending is not saved correctly.
4. w key doesn't work when pressed to activate objects.

These 4 glitches has been fixed now.

notes.title: Small patch to add options menu
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers!

I read your reviews and understood points to improve the game.

As a first step, I replaced language menu of title menu to options window where you can switch language, change resolutions, switch fullscreen mode and adjust volumes. It was harder than I expected(thanks to spaghetti code, apparently) but it definitely would make the game experience better.

Have any other suggestions, feel free to tell me. And enjoy Tentacle Manor!
